Fe-xMn-3Al-3Si+ 21-28 % MnReduced polarization resistance and increased corrosion current densityExcess Mn content leaded to insufficient Al enrichment in the oxide films[12]
Fe-25Mn-10Al-1.5 C+ 2 % Cr, + 2 % NiIncreased OCP and polarization resistance, reduced corrosion rateSuppressed early micro-galvanic effect, improved protective ability of passive film[13]
Fe-30Mn-10.5Al-1.1 C+ 3 % Cr, + 3 % MoIncreased pitting potentialThe passive film thickened and promoted the formation of Mo/Cr-rich passive film[20]
Fe-30Mn-8Al-1.2 C+ 2 % Cr, + 2 % MoDecreased corrosion current densityFormed a more protective oxide film and reduced amount of detrimental Mn oxides[21]
Fe-19Mn-12Al-1.5 C+ 5 % CrIncreased pitting potential but reduced film thicknessIncreased the Cr and Al content in the passive film and increased the oxide to hydroxide ratio[22]
Fe-30Mn-8Al-1C+ 3 % CuIncreased carbide formation and accelerated corrosion rateCu enriched at the GBs and combined with dissolved oxygen to form an unstable oxide film[23]
Fe-21Mn-10Al-1.25 C+ 3 % NiIncreased corrosion rateB2 phase at GBs enhanced microgalvanic corrosion, leading to inhomogeneous film[24]
Fe-20Mn-11.5Al-1.4 C+ 5 % CrHigher pitting potential compared with stainless steelFormed passive films thicker than stainless steel, with higher Cr+Al contents[25]
